name: RFC 8785 object-key canonicalization

source.note: Minimized from the RFC 8785 JCS writer used by ArgumentDigest: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code units, no insignificant whitespace. Numbers are i64 only so the crate has no serde_json dependency.

description: canonicalize must emit RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme text for a tiny JSON subset (null, bool, i64, string, array, object). Object keys are sorted by UTF-16 code units, there is no whitespace, and strings escape quote/backslash/controls. The seed inserts spaces and keeps object keys in insertion order, so equal objects compare unequal after canonicalize. Nested arrays and objects must recurse. ASCII keys may be sorted lexicographically; that matches UTF-16 for this subset.
